ProtectionPlans.baseDesc: The rate includes RCA Insurance (Civil Liability), unlimited mileage, and conventional reduction for damage (CDW) and theft (TLW). The customer is required to leave a security deposit as a guarantee and to be financially responsible according to the deductibles.
ProtectionPlans.topDesc: Enjoy a worry-free journey: zero excess for theft and damage (including roof and underbody), security deposit reduced to just €100, Personal Accident Insurance (P.A.I.), and Plus Roadside Assistance.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know before your trip.
FAQ.q1: What do I need to rent a car?
FAQ.a1: You need a valid driving licence, a credit card in the driver's name, and a valid ID or passport.
FAQ.q2: Where can I pick up and return the car?
FAQ.a2: Our main location is Cagliari Elmas Airport (CAG). We also offer delivery to select hotels and locations across Sardinia.
FAQ.a3: Yes, basic insurance (CDW/TPL) is included in all rentals. You can upgrade to full cover during booking.
FAQ.q4: Can I cancel or modify my reservation?
FAQ.a4: Free cancellation is available up to 48 hours before pick-up. Modifications can be made from your dashboard.
FAQ.q5: What fuel policy do you use?
FAQ.a5: We use a full-to-full fuel policy. Pick up with a full tank and return it full to avoid refuelling charges.
FAQ.q6: Do you offer child seats and GPS?
FAQ.a6: Yes, child seats, GPS navigation, and other extras can be added during the booking process.
